doc.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

chapter: Jump Town and the Ventura band
title: Roy writes the Ventura book in three weeks
summary: Roy writes the whole book for the Blue Note, Chicago engagement in 1948, including the bebop 'I'm Forever Blowing Bubbles' arrangement.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: And I wrote, they left the city and I wrote the whole book in three weeks, and it was tenor of course with Charlie, trumpet, baritone and trombone. And wrote the book for this engagement that started at the Blue Note in Chicago. And that was 1948 I believe.
And one of the tunes we did last night was from 1948 and the original bebop arrangement of “I’m Forever Blowing Bubbles.”
I was going to ask you about that.
That’s a lot of writing first of all, in three weeks.
I stayed at the piano and just wrote stuff out. I just stayed there for three weeks. And they came into town and we rehearsed and opened the next day.
And we just had enough to do for a show or two and that was all, and then stretch them out a little bit with the blowing.
